description: This file defines the EngineSnifferPanel class, which is a Swing-based UI component for visualizing engine sensor data, including charts and real-time images of engine signals. It manages panels, buttons, charts, and images, and interacts with engine state and configuration.

classes.name: EngineSnifferPanel
classes.description: A Swing component for displaying engine sensor data visualizations, including charts, images, controls, and status panels. Manages dynamic creation and update of visual elements based on engine state messages.

methods.name: EngineSnifferPanel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UI components, registers engine state listeners, and sets up event handlers.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Sets the paused state of the chart updates and updates the pause button label.

methods.name: setOutpinListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for external pin state updates, updating corresponding images.

methods.name: resetImagePanel
methods.description: Resets the image panel to contain only the main crank image.

methods.name: displayChart
methods.description: Parses engine chart data, updates images, status, and chart display accordingly.

methods.name: getPanel
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel containing the entire UI.

methods.name: createSecondaryImage
methods.description: Creates and adds a new UpDownImage for a given signal name if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: getInsertIndex
methods.description: Determines the insertion index for a new image based on comparator order.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves the current visualization as an image file with a timestamped filename.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Creates a new UpDownImage with signal color coding based on name prefix.

methods.name: reloadFile
methods.description: Reloads the current chart from the chart repository.

methods.name: getTabSelectedListener
methods.description: Returns an ActionListener to set focus on the command input when tab is selected.
